jobs.description:
Job ID: 6322
 
#Core of the core #Heart of the bank
 
Would you like to be part of the journey to create an even better version of us? At Nordea, we know our customers’ needs are changing – and we’re deeply committed to meeting them with financial solutions of tomorrow.
 
We are looking for a Senior or Expert IT Analyst (depending on seniority) to join Local Systems Operations in Sweden. Local Systems is a team loaded with experience, professionalism and passion. The Operations Unit within Local Systems is responsible for running our applications in a stable and compliant way. Now we need to add talent to the team, to stay in strength and competence also for the future.
 
About this opportunity
 
Welcome to the Local Systems team. We add value by providing stable, efficient and innovative IT services in the core banking system areas such as Deposits, Payments, Customer data and Loans, serving virtually all other business areas of the bank. As a Senior / Expert IT Analyst you will play a vital role in keeping Nordea’s fundamental banking applications running stable and compliant. You will support Application Providers working on a portfolio of applications constituting the foundation of the bank. In your role, you will support Nordeas vital Incident, Problem and Change processes. You will work on internal as well as external audits of different kinds, and provide technical support to Application Providers and other stakeholders.
 
What you’ll be doing: 
Be a technical support to Application Providers
Follow up on and guide our vendors, who are doing the bulk part of daily application operations.
Support and perform the activities in the Change, Incident and Problem Processes
Conduct compliance reviews, and if needed implement corrective measures
Cooperate with Application Providers to create an optimal environment for the applications evolution, including access to sufficient application competence over time

 
As the Senior/ Expert IT Analyst, you will focus on the applications health in a short and long term perspective, making sure Nordea has access to applications with world class functionality, scalability, maintainability and performance, now and in the future. To achieve this, you will be cooperating with many parts of Nordea, inside and outside Local Systems. Vendor Management will be a crucial activity, as many of the operational services of the applications are purchased from external vendors.
 
The Local Systems application portfolio is mainly built on the IBM z/OS (“Mainframe”) technical platform. A smaller part of the application portfolio is built on Midrange technologies, such as Java. To be successful, we believe you are well acquainted with these platforms, with a primary focus on the Mainframe.
 
This role is based in Stockholm, Sweden. This is a permanent, full-time, position.
 
Who you are
 
Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in being at our best – and that we imagine you share with us.
 
To succeed in this role, we believe that you: 
Have worked five years with banking applications
Are good at grasping rules and regulations, and realizing their practical consequences
Are well acquainted with IT Operations work
Have a structured mind with attention to detail
Can act independently, and identify the actions you need to take.
Have a positive attitude and cooperate easily with those you have contact with in your daily work
Have the capability to work with English speaking colleagues from all over the world.

 
Your experience and background:
You have five years of experience from the financial sector, primarily focused on software maintenance and/or development
You are skilled in and enjoy analysing IT solutions
Several years of experience from working with mainframe systems
Experience from ITIL and IPC Process work
Acquaintance with Nordeas systems, products and processes will be a big advantage

 
What we offer
 
People are driven by many different factors. For some, it’s to take their career to the next level. For others, it’s to break new ground within their area of expertise – in other words, with us, you will always move forward.
 
A culture that fosters performance and growth in one of the largest Nordic banks, offering various opportunities to evolve, develop and learn from brilliant colleagues with diverse backgrounds in a vibrant working environment.
 
Hybrid working model – we believe in the value of bringing people together and at the same time we embrace the freedom of flexibility.
 
Diversity and inclusion are a natural part of our daily work. We know that an inclusive workplace is a sustainable one. We genuinely believe that our diverse backgrounds, experiences, characteristics and traits make us stronger together. Every day we strive to find new ways to improve diversity and inclusion within our community e.g. we have signed the European Diversity Charters in the countries where we operate to show our commitment and engage with others to continue learning and improving.
 
If this sounds like you, get in touch!
 
Next steps
 
Submit your application no later than 20/11/2026. For more information, you’re welcome to contact Head of Local Systems Operations and Local Systems Application Management, Johan Larsson at johan.larsson@nordea.com.
 
The recruitment process consists of the following steps:
Preliminary CV selection
Phone conversation with the recruiter or hiring leader
Online interview with the hiring leader
Reference check

 
For union information, please contact Finansförbundet at finansforbundet@nordea.se or SACO at SacoNordea@nordea.com.

jobs.description:
As a Senior Digital Product Designer, you independently lead complex and ambiguous initiatives, mentor more junior designers, and contribute to the overall experience of quality. You identify opportunities, frame problems, sequence of work and own design decisions within the product team, and sometimes across multiple teams. You shape direction with cross-functional partners, connect experience outcomes to product value and improve quality through scalable methodologies. 
WHAT YOU’LL DO 
Proactively improve the experience for users, finding opportunities, solving complex problems, and creating complex experience design strategies. 
Plan and lead complex, ambiguous initiatives from discovery through delivery for their team including defining the design approach and facilitating exploratory workshops, as required. 
Shape product discovery, vision and roadmap decisions within the product team with Product Manager, Engineering, Data and Research. 
Conduct and synthesize appropriate qualitative and quantitative research with Research and Data partners. Design coherent user flows, prototypes, and polished interfaces, based on the validated customer insights that result from that research. 
Connect user needs, business goals and technical constraints through systems thinking. Apply principles of component-based design as part of using H&M’s internal and customer facing digital design systems. (BADS, FABRIC, RADS etc.). Use and contribute to the relevant design system. 
Scope and sequence work, resolve dependencies, and identify risks early. 
Define and interpret experience measures to understand impact. 
Run iterative testing with customers to improve usability. 
Ensure designs align with brand guidelines and accessibility / inclusive standards (WCAG), when relevant. 
Define success measures with partners, test assumptions, and iterate based on evidence. 
Support Product Delivery with Engineering partners so releases deliver the value as intended. 
Work closely with design leads including integrating feedback and proactive iteration. Actively mentor designers, raises design and experience quality in craft, strategy and deliveries across teams and contributes to improving the wider design practice. 
Collaborate effectively within multi-disciplinary teams, presenting and testing design concepts with other product team members. 
Present design concepts to stakeholders to improve skills in articulating design and defending design decisions. 
Maintain documentation and follow existing structures and processes or create new ones where they don’t exist. 
Partners with other leading roles in the product team, and wider product area, to influence the customer perspective. 
Actively shape the Design Community by mentoring others, driving knowledge-sharing, contributing to design standards and championing behaviours that strengthen the design culture across teams. 

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH 
You will be part of the Digital Unit, a mix of Product Managers, Digital Product Designers, Data Analysts, and Commercial Managers. You’ll collaborate closely with colleagues in Tech, Marketing, Creative Development, and Customer Service. 
WHO YOU ARE 
We are looking for people with… 
Minimum of 8 years relevant experience. 
Strong track record of independently leading complex product design work and delivering high quality that results in improved commercial outcomes. 
Expert knowledge of user-centered design methods with demonstrated experience working in multiple product teams across both product discovery and delivery in different product areas and/or industries. 
Demonstrated experience in strategic thinking, advanced storytelling skills, and the ability to balance and communicate user needs with business goals, brand direction, and technical feasibility. 
Demonstrated experience in framing ambiguous problems and synthesizing mixed evidence. 
Advanced skills in interaction design, UI execution, prototyping, customer journeys, and scalability principles (e.g. design systems). 
Demonstrated ability to select methods, conduct research and usability testing, and interpret basic product or experience measures. 
Advanced proficiency with tools for design, development and collaboration such as Figma, Miro, Jira, and AI design tools such as Figma Make and Claude Design. Demonstrated experience using research and analytics tools such as Google Analytics and Hotjar to evaluate complex experience outcomes and inform design decisions. 
Confident stakeholder manager, workshop facilitator and storyteller. 
Experience following (and promoting) accessibility (WCAG) and inclusive design best practices, when relevant. 
Experience in running complex or high-volume user research and usability testing. 
Demonstrated experience in mentoring more junior designers and improving product team practices. 

WHO WE ARE 
H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make. 
We are thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by a shared culture and strong values. Together, we aim to use our scale and knowledge to push the industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. 
WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE 
At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer: 
Global career and development opportunities 
A value‑driven culture where you are encouraged to be yourself 
Staff discount cards and benefits 
Wellness and wellbeing benefits 
Parental support 
Opportunities to experiment, grow, and create tangible impact in a large‑scale tech organization 

Here, you are encouraged to be yourself, experiment, and grow — and as you flourish, so do we. 
JOIN US 
Our uniqueness comes from our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and the growth opportunities we create. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are. 
Take the next step in your career — the journey starts here. 
Please attach your CV in English only together with your portfolio if you have one — no cover letter is needed.

Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match. 
WELCOME TO THE TEAM!
The Volvo Group culture is defined by a set of five carefully chosen values- Customer success, Trust, Passion, Change, and Performance. These values guide our day-to-day behavior and drive our decision-making at all levels of the organization. They express our shared beliefs across countries and entities to form the basis for a high-performing culture that can help maximize the full potential of the organization. Our company values help guide us on that journey.
About the Role
As a Senior System Verification Engineer for Connectivity, you will be part of a collaborative and enthusiastic team working cross-functionally to verify the complete connected system, from onboard electronics and communication networks to cloud services, remote diagnostics, and software updates.
Working in an agile environment, you will drive end-to-end connectivity verification and take technical ownership of verification strategies, system and integration testing, test automation, and complex troubleshooting. Through close collaboration across Volvo CE and Volvo Group, you will influence technical solutions, strengthen verification practices, and help ensure robust, secure, and reliable connectivity for our customers.
If you are excited about solving complex technical challenges and seeing the real-world impact of your engineering, this could be the role for you.
Who are you?
You enjoy solving complex, real-world engineering problems and are curious about how connected technologies can make machines smarter, safer, and more productive. You combine a system-level mindset with hands-on technical capability and enjoy understanding how distinct parts of a connected system work together.
You value collaboration, share ideas openly and take ownership of your work. You enjoy working in cross-functional and international teams, learning from others, and contributing your own expertise. You communicate effectively in English and are comfortable taking initiative and exploring innovative approaches to technical challenges. 
What will make you successful in this role:
Strong Experience in connectivity, embedded systems, telematics, or system verification, preferably within automotive, construction equipment or other complex embedded systems.
Good understanding of communication and connectivity technologies such as CAN, Ethernet, TCP/IP, cellular networks, Wi-Fi & machine-to-cloud communication.
Hands-on experience with system and integration testing, troubleshooting and root-cause analysis across hardware and software.
Knowledge of OTA/Remote Software Download, remote diagnostics and connected services is highly valued.
Experience with test automation, scripting, and CI/CD-based verification, with the ability to identify opportunities for increased automation.
Understanding of cybersecurity principles, diagnostics, and communication protocols for connected systems
Ability to work across ECUs, machines, connectivity infrastructure, and cloud/back-office systems with an end-to-end system perspective.
A collaborative mindset, strong technical curiosity, and the ability to take ownership and solve complex system-level problems.

What’s in it for you?
The role is based on-site at our Technology Center in Eskilstuna, where you will have direct access to our machines, test rigs, and modern verification facilities. This gives you the opportunity to test solutions in real environments and collaborate closely with development teams and other stakeholders. You will have opportunities to deepen your technical expertise, explore modern technologies, and grow your career within a large international organization.
In addition to technology and career opportunities, we offer a solid package of compensation and benefits, including flexible time, internal growth opportunities, and compensation benefits such as Occupational pension – ITP (ITP1 & ITP2), profit sharing, and company bonus. We value our employees’ well-being, work-life balance and having fun at work.
Ready for the next move?
If you are curious to explore how we put our words into actions, follow us on LinkedIn and volvogroup.com.
Last day to apply: 6 December 2026.
Location: Eskilstuna, Technology Center Headquarters, on-site only!
For questions about the position, please contact: Kumar Mrinal, Head of System Verification ( Mrinal.kumar@volvo.com ) or Talent Acquisition Partner Olof Person, (olof.person@volvo.com)
As part of the recruitment process, a background check as well as alcohol and drug testing may be conducted. You will be informed if applicable. We look forward to receiving your application!
We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail. 
Who we are and what we believe in 
We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities.
Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join Volvo Group. Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. ​We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. ​We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment. 
Part of Volvo Group, Volvo Construction Equipment is a global company driven by our purpose to build the world we want to live in. Together we develop and deliver solutions for a cleaner, smarter, and more connected world. By unleashing everyone’s full potential, we build a more sustainable future for all our stakeholders. Come join our team and help us build a better tomorrow.

jobs.description:
(English text below)
Om jobbet
Söker du ett aktivt, praktiskt arbete där du får vara med och tillverka hälsoprodukter från grunden? Hos Swedish Nutra i Mellersta Hamnen, Malmö, är ditt huvudsakliga fokus den dagliga produktionen av våra flytande kosttillskott. Samtidigt värdesätter vi ett praktiskt och mekaniskt intresse—vi söker dig som gillar teknik och vill lära dig hur vår produktionsutrustning fungerar.
Vi är ett starkt växande familjeföretag där kvalitet alltid går före kvantitet. Du behöver inte ha lång tidigare erfarenhet; har du rätt inställning, god noggrannhet och ett tekniskt handlag utbildar vi dig grundligt på plats!
Arbetsuppgifter
Rollen kombinerar praktiskt produktionsarbete med ett naturligt engagemang i våra maskiner:
Produktion (Huvudfokus): Aktivt delta i den dagliga tillverkningen, blandningen, fyllningen, etiketteringen och emballeringen av våra produkter.
Maskindrift & Underhåll: Lära dig vår produktionsutrustning för att sköta omställningar, övervaka drift, utföra löpande rengöring samt hantera allt från lättare förebyggande underhåll till mer omfattande tekniska arbeten vid behov.
Kvalitet & Hygien: Säkerställa att produkterna hanteras korrekt och att produktionslokalerna håller högsta renhets- och hygienstandard.

Arbetstider & Anställningsvillkor
Heltid (40 h/vecka), dagtid.
Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning (vi tillämpar provanställning).
Arbetet är fysiskt och tyngre lyft förekommer i det dagliga flödet.

Vem söker vi?
Praktisk & Drivande: Du trivs med fysiskt produktionsarbete och att se färdiga produkter lämna linjen.
Mekaniskt intresse: Du har en naturlig känsla för teknik, tycker om att förstå hur maskiner fungerar och trivs med praktiskt arbete.
Noggrann & Kvalitetsmedveten: Du är exakt i ditt arbete och förstår vikten av noggrann hygien.
Språk: Goda/flytande kunskaper i antingen svenska och engelska är ett krav.
Meriterande: Erfarenhet inom produktion, maskindrift eller underhåll (gärna inom kosttillskott, livsmedel, läkemedel eller kosmetika).

Om Swedish Nutra
Swedish Nutra är ett Malmöbaserat familjeföretag som tillverkar flytande kosttillskott för en global marknad. Hos oss möter du ett ungt, drivet och mångkulturellt team där engelska är en helt naturlig del av vardagen. Vi erbjuder en varm och engagerande arbetsmiljö där varje medarbetare räknas och där det finns goda möjligheter att växa.
Arbetsplats: Swedish Nutra AB, Lodgatan 19, 211 24 Malmö.
Ansökan & Viktig information
Intervjuer sker löpande och tillsättning kan ske omgående. Skicka ditt CV och personliga brev till: hr@swedishnutra.com
⚠️ VIKTIGT ANGÅENDE DIN ANSÖKAN ⚠️
På grund av hög e-postvolym sorteras alla ansökningar automatiskt. För att ditt mail ska synas och hamna rätt måste du använda följande ämnesrad:
Ämnesrad: 🔧PRODUKTION & TEKNIK🔧 Ansökan: [Ditt Förnamn + Efternamn]
(Exempel: 🔧PRODUKTION & TEKNIK🔧 Ansökan: Anna Andersson)
Observera: Vi gör alltid vårt bästa för att återkoppla till alla, men på grund av högt tryck har vi tyvärr inte möjlighet att besvara varje ansökan individuellt. Om du inte har blivit kontaktad inom två veckor har vi gått vidare med andra kandidater. Stort tack för ditt intresse!

Process & Machinery Operator – Liquid Supplements
About the Job
Looking for an active, hands-on role manufacturing high-quality health products from start to finish? At Swedish Nutra in Mellersta Hamnen, Malmö, your main daily focus will be running our liquid supplement production line. We also place great value on practical technical curiosity—we are looking for someone who enjoys working with machinery and wants to master how our equipment operates.
We are a fast-growing family company where quality always takes priority over quantity. Extensive industry experience isn't required; if you bring a strong work ethic, keen attention to detail, and a practical technical mindset, we will fully train you on-site!
Key Responsibilities
This role combines daily hands-on manufacturing with active involvement in machine operations:
Production (Main Focus): Take an active role in daily manufacturing, including ingredient mixing, bottling, labeling, and final packaging.
Machine Operation & Upkeep: Master our production equipment to handle line changeovers, monitor operations, perform routine cleaning, and assist with preventative maintenance troubleshooting when needed.
Quality & Hygiene: Maintain strict standards for hygiene, product handling, and overall workplace cleanliness.

Working Hours & Terms
Full-time (40 hours/week), day shifts only.
Employment type: Permanent position (probationary period applies).
The role involves physical labor and heavy lifting.

Qualifications
Hands-on Drive: You thrive in an active factory environment and enjoy seeing products go from raw ingredients to finished goods.
Technical Aptitude: You have a natural curiosity for machinery, like understanding how equipment works, and enjoy practical problem-solving.
Detail-Oriented & Quality-Minded: You work with high accuracy and recognize the vital importance of strict food and hygiene standards.
Languages: Good language skill in English and Swedish is required
Pluses: Prior experience in manufacturing, machine operation, or equipment maintenance (especially within food, supplements, pharma, or cosmetics).

About Swedish Nutra
Swedish Nutra is a Malmö-based family business producing premium liquid supplements distributed worldwide. We offer a warm, collaborative workplace culture where every team member is valued and given room to grow.
Location: Swedish Nutra AB, Lodgatan 19, 211 24 Malmö, Sweden
How to Apply & Important Information
Applications are reviewed continuously and onboarding can start immediately. Send your CV and cover letter to: hr@swedishnutra.com
⚠️ IMPORTANT APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS ⚠️
Due to high email volume, applications are sorted automatically. To ensure your email is processed correctly, you must use the exact subject line format below:
Subject Line: 🔧PRODUKTION & TEKNIK🔧 Application: [Your First & Last Name]
(Example: 🔧PRODUKTION & TEKNIK🔧 Application: John Doe)
Please note: We always try our best to reach out to everyone, but due to the high volume of applications, we may not be able to respond to every applicant individually. If you haven't heard from us within two weeks, it means we have moved forward with other candidates for this role. We sincerely appreciate your interest!

Ready to find your path? Try new things. Share experiences. And discover what you truly enjoy.

Your role

Your role as a specialist in Data-Centric Architecture
Your role is to pivot our data strategy from application-centric silos to a unified, data-centric ecosystem.
 
This role is essential
The ability to maintain a single, consistent version of the truth is critical. Without a robust semantic framework, the data remains fragmented.
 
Expectations
We expect you to lead the design and implementation of ontologies and semantic layers. You will own and define the metadata management strategy as well, ensuring that data is not only stored but is discoverable, traceable, and governed. Your focus will be on creating flexible architecture.
The main purpose with the Specialist role is to act as a technical leader within the designated technical area. That means driving the development of the technical area, anticipating future trends and directions, understanding risks and opportunities and most important of all, drive and advocate for necessary change.
External and international relations are essential parts to gather insights, co-create and increase knowledge. This includes relations with academia, partners as well as customers.
 
While assigned to a specific line organization, Specialists work for the benefit of Saab as a whole. Appointments are made for a three-year term (2026-2028), with at least 20% of your time dedicated to specialist activities.
 
As part of the Specialist program, you will meet and interact with other specialists at Saab. Every year there is an inspirational Surveillance Specialist Day, and you will also have the opportunity to engage in mentorship programs and courses to enhance your skills and knowledge. You will develop and maintain a written specialist plan, outlining your vision and strategy for your technical area, in dialogue with your manager and other stakeholders. You regularly communicate your plan and vision, to inspire, share insights and push boundaries. 

 

Your profile

You are a rare hybrid: a strategic architect who is equally at home in a high-level stakeholder meeting as you are in a code editor. You believe that great architecture is only as good as its implementation, and you possess the technical discipline to build the semantic layers and ontologies you design. You are a "builder" at heart, someone who finds satisfaction in transforming a theoretical data model into a production-ready, scalable system.
 
Your skills and knowledge
You bring a deep, hands-on mastery of data-centric technologies. You don't just understand ontologies; you have experience with technologies such as RDF, OWL, and/or SHACL. You are proficient in querying and manipulating complex data structures using for example SPARQL and/or GraphQL. You have a strong command of programming to build the glue code and APIs that make a semantic layer functional.
Your experience with metadata management isn't just theoretical; you have built automated pipelines for metadata extraction and you might have integrated data catalogs into active development workflows. You are comfortable with Graph databases and you might even know how to optimize them for performance at scale.
 
Specific requirements
For this position, a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Physics or a related technical field is essential, along with a proven portfolio of implemented data architectures. You must be proficient in version control (Git) and familiar with CI/CD pipelines for data infrastructure. Fluent communication in Swedish and English, both verbal and written, is essential for collaborating with our teams.
 
You are a curious and collaborative engineer who enjoys learning, sharing insights, and being inspired by others. You communicate in ways that create understanding and drive positive changes, while developing both your own competence and that of those around you. You may already take the lead in some situations or be ready to grow into it and you enjoy supporting others in contributing and developing.
You take an interest in understanding the broader business context, including customers, competitors, products, priorities, and financial considerations. As a specialist, you will contribute your expertise and perspective to driving the transformation and competitiveness of our Surveillance capabilities.
 
This specialist assignment offers an opportunity to broaden your experience, add variation to your everyday work, and support your long‑term career development. You build trust through open communication with teams, customers, and project stakeholders, contribute ideas, and take initiative to identify opportunities and work more efficiently helping both people and our organization move forward.
 
This position requires that you pass a security vetting based on the current regulations around/of security protection. For positions requiring security clearance additional obligations on citizenship may apply.

 

What you will be a part of

Explore a wealth of possibilities. Take on challenges, create smart inventions, and grow beyond. This is a place for curious minds, brave pioneers, and everyone in between. Together, we achieve the extraordinary, each bringing our unique perspectives. Your part matters.
 
Saab is a leading defense and security company with an enduring purpose, to help nations keep their people and society safe. Empowered by its 28,000 talented people, Saab constantly pushes the boundaries of technology to create a safer and more sustainable world.
Saab designs, manufactures and maintains advanced systems in aeronautics, weapons, command and control, sensors and underwater systems. Saab is headquartered in Sweden. It has major operations all over the world and is part of the domestic defense capability of several nations. Read more about us here

jobs.occupation: Child and adolescent psychiatrist – Work on a Nordic Island
jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!
Are you looking for a meaningful specialist position where you can combine professional development with a high quality of life?
This is an opportunity to work within child and adolescent psychiatry in a close-knit Nordic healthcare environment, while living in a peaceful island community surrounded by nature and the sea.
About the Island
This Nordic island is home to approximately 30,000 residents and offers a safe, peaceful and family-friendly environment. With its beautiful archipelago, clean air and easy access to outdoor activities such as hiking, sailing and cycling, the island provides excellent opportunities for an active lifestyle outside of work.
For professionals considering relocation with their families, the island offers schools, daycare services and a welcoming community within a compact geographical area.
About the psychiatric service
The child and adolescent psychiatric service covers the entire island and serves approximately 5,900 children and adolescents aged 0–17.
The service is primarily outpatient-based and currently has around 140 active patients, with approximately 210 referrals per year. About 50% of referrals relate to neurodevelopmental conditions, making ADHD and autism an important part of the clinical work.
Common psychiatric conditions include:
Depression
Anxiety disorders
Obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD)
ADHD
Autism
Other child and adolescent psychiatric conditions

Treatment includes psychological and psychotherapeutic interventions, pharmacological treatment, psychoeducation and support for both patients and their families.
When needed, the team also collaborates with schools, social services and other healthcare providers.
About the Role
As a specialist in child and adolescent psychiatry, you will have a broad and varied clinical role with the opportunity to follow patients throughout their assessment and treatment.
Your responsibilities will include:
Assessing, diagnosing and treating children and adolescents with a broad range of psychiatric conditions
Working with both general psychiatric and neurodevelopmental conditions, including ADHD and autism
Developing and following up individualized treatment plans
Providing pharmacological treatment when appropriate
Working closely with psychologists, nurses, social workers and other healthcare professionals
Collaborating with families, schools, social services and other healthcare providers when needed
Participating in clinical discussions and contributing your specialist expertise to the multidisciplinary team
Supporting and mentoring residents and junior doctors
Contributing to the continued development of the psychiatric service

Physicians typically see approximately 4–5 patients per day, alongside clinical rounds, acute assessments and other outpatient responsibilities.
There may also be opportunities for further professional development and increased responsibility within the organization.
Outpatient Work and Acute Psychiatry
The work is predominantly outpatient-based. The child and adolescent psychiatric service does not have its own inpatient ward or separate on-call service.
Acute cases are primarily handled through a reserved acute appointment at the outpatient clinic each week. Other urgent cases may present through the emergency department or psychiatric inpatient services.
When required, the initial assessment can be carried out by the on-call physician within adult psychiatry, in consultation with the child and adolescent psychiatric team.
If a patient requires inpatient care, this is arranged in cooperation with adult psychiatry or the paediatric department, depending on the patient's age, clinical needs and availability.
This structure allows you to focus primarily on planned outpatient psychiatric care while still being involved in acute assessments when required.
Requirements
We are looking for a specialist who:
Holds an EU-recognized specialist qualification in child and adolescent psychiatry
Has broad clinical experience in assessing and treating psychiatric conditions in children and adolescents
Is comfortable working with neurodevelopmental conditions such as ADHD and autism
Can work independently while also enjoying close multidisciplinary collaboration
Has strong communication skills and a patient- and family-centered approach
Is interested in contributing to the professional development of colleagues and junior doctors
Communicates well in English and is motivated to learn Swedish

Why consider this opportunity?
Work-life balance: Outpatient-based work with no dedicated on-call duties within the child and adolescent psychiatric service.
Broad clinical role: Work across child and adolescent psychiatry, with significant exposure to ADHD, autism and other psychiatric conditions.
Collaborative environment: Join a close multidisciplinary team and contribute with your specialist expertise.
Nordic island lifestyle: Enjoy a safe, family-friendly community surrounded by nature and the sea.

What Dignus Medical Offers You
Relocating to another country is a major decision. We will support you throughout the process, from first contact until you are established in your new position.
We offer:
Personal and ongoing support from your dedicated recruiter
Assistance with authorization and specialist recognition when required
Support throughout the relocation process
Assistance related to accommodation and practical relocation matters
Support for accompanying family members
Access to language training with a private tutor via Teams or Skype

Take the Next Step in Your Career
If you are a specialist in child and adolescent psychiatry looking for an opportunity to combine meaningful clinical work with a different way of life, this could be the right next step for you.
Apply today or contact us to learn more about the position and life on this unique Nordic island.

Do you love designing clean game architecture, building multiplayer systems that run smoothly, and helping a team of programmers make the right technical decisions? Great! Let's talk.

Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by a simple mission: to make everyone laugh.

And just to be very clear: this is a technical leadership role, not a people-management position.

Here's what that looks like day to day

In collaboration with game designers, artists, and other programmers, you'll build new features and systems and continuously iterate on improvements. We all work in Unity with C#, with every team member hands-on in the editor

You'll set and communicate the project's technical direction, turning creative goals and production needs into clear technical priorities

You'll review and improve technical solutions, share best practices, and support other programmers without becoming a gatekeeper or bottleneck

You'll proactively identify technical risks, messy systems, and missing foundations, and take responsibility for addressing them at the right time

Overall, you'll make sure the project is technically healthy and maintain the codebase in a way that makes it easy for others to build on

This includes things like...

Designing an architecture that allows for easy gameplay implementation and flexibility

Implementing and maintaining online features such as matchmaking, invites and friends

Profiling and improving network performance, bandwidth and latency, and making sure the game holds up on real-world connections

Breaking down complex technical challenges, helping decide what to prioritise, and ensuring important decisions are understood by the people they affect

Staying close to the actual game: writing production code, debugging difficult problems, and improving systems as the project evolves

You have at least ten years of professional game development experience across multiple shipped games and different stages of development, including significant technical ownership or leadership on a project

You have experience setting technical direction and helping a programming team make and implement architectural decisions, with strong judgment in balancing flexibility, maintainability, performance and the needs of a creative production

You're highly proficient in C# and have deep knowledge of the Unity engine and editor

You've shipped at least one online multiplayer game, had real ownership of its networking/online systems, and have hands-on experience with a Unity multiplayer framework (e.g., Coherence)

You communicate clearly and can explain technical decisions and trade-offs to programmers and non-programmers alike

Nice to haves

You have experience shipping iOS and macOS apps, including hands-on integration of Apple platform services such as GameKit and the Game Controller framework using Xcode and Swift

Experience with backend services, dedicated servers or cloud hosting for online games

Interest in multiplayer game design and social features

Experience working with automated build pipelines such as Jenkins

Experience building systemic or open-world games

What always matters to us at Triband

You thrive in taking ownership of your area: you spot problems, seek advice when needed, and implement creative solutions that push projects forward

You're motivated by collaboration, mutual respect, inclusiveness and creativity while actively contributing to sustaining that culture

You believe games are made by teams, not rockstars and that great ideas can come from anyone

You bring curiosity, generosity, and flexibility, along with strong opinions, especially when they come with reasoning, openness, and a willingness to actually test them

You love exploration and experimentation but don't get too precious when the evidence tells you you're wrong

You value a positive work environment and contribute to keeping the studio a fun and supportive place to be

Practicalities

We work on-site at our cozy office in central Copenhagen.

For this role we also consider people located outside of Denmark and provide financial (and moral!) support with visa application and relocation.

We work a 37-hour work week, with core hours 10-15, and the freedom to start and finish anywhere between 7 and 18.

Friendly and kind colleagues who love making each other laugh as much as making games.

Child's first sick day on us, no questions asked.

Endless amounts of Faxe Kondi.

Job Description
Do you have experience in chemical product regulatory compliance and enjoy turning complex legislation into practical solutions? Are you motivated by applying your regulatory experience across global markets and helping the business bring compliant products to our customers? Then this could be the opportunity for you!  

WHAT YOU'LL DO  
We are now looking for a Product Compliance Specialist with a strong regulatory background and experience in chemical products (e.g. scented candles, room scents, glue). In this role, you will be part of the Product Compliance team and focus on chemical compliance as well as product labelling requirements. 
The Product Compliance department brings together specialists across different areas of product compliance and safety. We are responsible for setting requirements and routines for all products sold by the H&M group, in line with legislation and product safety. We research and find regulatory information concerning product safety and legal requirements in new, as well as established markets, and for new products. By supporting several parts of our business with our expertise, we contribute to the overall customer experience. 
In this role you will have a broad end-to-end responsibility, securing requirements connected to product, ingredients, labelling and product reporting. The main responsibilities will include:  
Monitor legislation for chemical products on existing selling markets and ensure that H&M Group’s internal requirements and routines are up to date 
Research requirements for chemical products to enable expansion, for new markets and new products 
Secure compliance with REACH and REACH-like regulations, e.g. EU REACH, UK REACH, KKDIK; investigate legal requirements on existing- and expansion markets, secure that internal routines for formulated products are up to date and implemented in production, follow-up on quantities and certificates 
Manage mandatory product reporting and notification requirements in designated markets, ensuring timely and accurate submissions to meet critical regulatory deadlines 
Monitor and interpret regulatory requirements for product and online labelling of chemical products, assess their impact on the business, and translate them into clear compliance requirements and guidance. Transform complex regulatory requirements into user-friendly information and guidelines in order to enable compliance. 
Support global authority inspections, audits, and regulatory inquiries by coordinating responses and providing the required information.  
Collaborate with, support and train colleagues and other stakeholders to ensure regulatory requirements are understood and effectively implemented. 

WHO YOU ARE 
We're looking for someone who combines a relevant academic background with hands-on experience from relevant industry and/or working within a regulatory authority. You're comfortable navigating complex regulatory requirements and can translate your expertise into clear, practical guidance for the business. You enjoy taking ownership of your area of expertise while collaborating with different stakeholders and making complex regulatory information accessible to others. 
 
We are looking for a person with... 
A degree in chemistry, toxicology, or similar field 
At least two years' experience working with chemical product regulatory compliance 
Hands-on experience working with CLP and REACH regulations  
Knowledge of the Biocidal Products Regulation is considered an advantage 
Experience working with regulatory requirements for chemical consumer products such as candles, room scents or similar product categories is a strong plus  
Strong communication skills in English (Swedish is considered an advantage)  

And a person who is... 
Driven, adaptable and comfortable applying your expertise to different business needs  
Able to take ownership and work independently while being a strong team player 
Skilled at making complex information simple and accessible, always with the business and customer in mind 
Business and customer-focused, with the ability to balance regulatory requirements with business needs

This is a full-time permanent position based from our Head Office in Stockholm, reporting to the Group Manager for Compliance. If you feel that your experience, skills and ambitions are right for this role, please send your resume in English at your earliest opportunity. Interviews will be conducted on a rolling basis.

H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make. 
We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together we want to use our power, our scale and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. Read more about us here 

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE 
At H&M Group we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe.

25% Staff discount on all our H&M Group brands both in stores and online (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories and ARKET). 
H&M Incentive Programme – HIP. Learn more about the programme here. 

JOIN US 
Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it is our people who make us who we are.

jobs.description:
Department of Clinical Sciences
Do you have clinical experience as a small animal veterinarian and are a board-certified specialist, or have equivalent qualifications, in animal reproduction? An opportunity has arisen to join the Small Animal Department at the University Animal Hospital (UDS), working with reproduction and general veterinary care in a setting closely integrated with research and the teaching of veterinary-and veterinary nursing students. We look forward to receiving your application!
About the position
As a licensed veterinarian and reproduction specialist at UDS, you will work at the Reproduction Clinic. The clinic provides diagnostic services and treatment for diseases of the reproductive organs, optimisation of mating timing, investigation and management of oestrus cycle disorders, fertility assessments, as well as semen collection and cryopreservation and artificial insemination (AI).
You will also participate in general veterinary care as part of the varied day-to-day activities at Sweden's only university animal hospital, which operates around the clock.
The position includes evening, night and weekend shifts. Our operations run 24 hours a day, seven days a week.
You will receive support from our specialists and experienced colleagues in the team, helping you to feel at home in the clinic and develop professionally in your role.
As SLU is Sweden's only institution providing higher education for animal health professionals, you will play an active role in educating the veterinarians and veterinary nurses of the future, both in the clinical setting and through other teaching activities in animal reproduction.
You will also devote some of your time to reproductive research, with opportunities to apply for your own research funding or participate in other research projects. Our reproductive research is highly active and encompasses all animal species and all aspects of reproduction. The Department has access to advanced laboratory techniques, enabling both in vivo and in vitro studies, and benefits from well-established national and international collaborations.
Your profile
You are a licensed veterinarian authorised to practise veterinary medicine in Sweden. You have several years of clinical experience working at a small animal clinic. You are a Diplomate and a specialist in animal reproduction, with a subspecialty in small animal reproduction (or have equivalent qualifications). We would like you to have experience as a reproduction veterinarian, with the skills required to perform routine procedures such as insemination, semen collection and cryopreservation.
As the position involves extensive contact with animal owners and students, you must have a good command of Swedish, both spoken and written, or have a good proficiency in English and be motivated to learn Swedish. The Department will support you in developing your Swedish language skills.
At the University Animal Hospital, we are customer-focused and committed to maintaining a professional approach characterised by goodwill and a positive attitude in our relationships with clients and colleagues. You are an effective communicator with the ability to establish and maintain good relationships with both clients and colleagues. You have an interest in teaching and in contributing to an environment that provides good conditions for research. As a veterinarian at the University Animal Hospital, you take a scientific approach to your work and have an interest in evidence-based veterinary medicine. You understand that working in an emergency service, where workloads are driven by unpredictable events and working hours are irregular, requires flexibility and adaptability.
As a person, you are well-organised, have good self-awareness and an understanding of what causes you stress, and are motivated to contribute to the organisation. In this recruitment process, great emphasis will be placed on your personal qualities and competencies.
About us
The Department of Clinical Sciences is responsible for undergraduate education, research and postgraduate education in the fields of anaesthesiology, diagnostic imaging, veterinary nursing, epidemiology, laboratory animal science, surgery, clinical chemistry, medicine and reproduction. Our activities in all these fields encompass all animal species.
At the Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU), University Animal Hospital (UDS), education, research and advanced veterinary care go hand in hand. 
Under one roof, we provide veterinary care for horses, dogs, cats and other small animals. In addition to modern facilities specifically designed for our operations, we have access to advanced diagnostic imaging equipment and a specialist veterinary diagnostic laboratory.
Read more about our benefits and working at SLU by visiting: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/

Uppsala, Sweden
Form of employment:
Indefinite-term employment. We use 6 months probationary employment.
Scope:
100%
Start date:
As agreed.

Please submit your application before deadline 7 December 2026. Applications cannot be submitted through the recruitment system on 20–22 November due to a system update.
Please include in your application: 
Curriculum Vitae (CV)
Letter of intent
Copies of appropriate degree certificates

https://internt.slu.se/en/my-employment/employee-associations/kontaktpersoner-vid-rekrytering/
 
 
The Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU) has a key role in the development for sustainable life, based on science and education. Through our focus on the interaction between humans, animals and ecosystems and the responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable societal development and good living conditions on our planet. Our main campuses are located in Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, however, the university also operates at research stations, experimental forests and teaching sites throughout Sweden. SLU has around 4,000 employees, 6,000 students and doctoral students and a turnover of over SEK 4,5 billion. We are investing in attractive environments on all of our campuses. We strive to provide a work environment characterised by inclusivity and gender equality, where different experiences generate conversations between people and pave the way for science, creativity and development. Therefore, we welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds and perspectives.

Engineering foundation — a degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Mechatronics, or a related field, combined with a solid background in R&D for electromechanical products gained through hands-on engineering, product development, or early-career coordination roles.
Product lifecycle expertise — demonstrated experience managing the full development lifecycle, from concept and validation through to industrialisation and continuous improvement, with a strong understanding of systems, spare parts, and lifecycle stewardship.

Compliance and quality awareness — familiarity with relevant safety and quality standards such as ISO, CE, EN16005, and UL, and a structured approach to process optimisation and regulatory adherence.

We equally welcome candidates who bring technical curiosity, analytical strength, and the motivation to grow into a product ownership role. An interest in emerging technologies such as IoT, connectivity, and AI is highly valued.

 
You are a natural leader who guides with clarity and purpose — someone who inspires confidence in a team not through authority alone, but through genuine engagement, consistent follow-through, and a willingness to roll up your sleeves when it matters. You think in possibilities, approaching technical tasks with creativity and a structured mind, always looking for smarter ways forward.
You are customer-centric by nature, with a keen sense of how engineering decisions translate into real-world impact — both for end users and for the business. You balance technical depth with pragmatic judgement, knowing when to dive into the details and when to step back and see the bigger picture. Proficiency in spoken and written English and Swedish is essential. Additional languages are a welcome advantage.

jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral researcher in Mechanical Engineering within Gear Technology
jobs.description:
We are looking for a postdoctoral researcher in Mechanical Engineering for a two-year fixed-term position at the School of Science and Technology.
Subject area
The subject area for this position is Mechanical Engineering with a focus on Gear Technology.
Background
A postdoctoral researcher will be affiliated with the group of Mechanical Engineering within the School of Science and Technology and will conduct research as part of the KKS project ‘Applying advanced mechano-chemical surface treatment for optimizing gear production process’. Specific areas of interest are Gear Tribology Testing, Contact Surface Simulation, and Gear Manufacturing. The current research project aims to study several technologies together to develop an optimized heat and surface treatment approach for production of high-load vehicle gears. A mechano-chemical surface treatment with combined change of surface chemistry, hardness and roughness is to be developed and integrated into existing methods to enhance gear performance with minimal environmental footprint and reduced production time and cost.
Duties and responsibilities
The appointment as a postdoctoral researcher is intended to enable persons who have recently been awarded their doctoral degree to consolidate and develop primarily their research skills. Besides consolidating their research and publication track, the postdocs may be required to contribute to the departmental duties (e.g., via teaching at the undergraduate or graduate level), up to 20 % of their time.
Qualifications
Those qualified for appointment as a postdoctoral researcher are applicants who at the time of appointment hold a doctoral degree or have a degree from abroad deemed to correspond to a doctoral degree in a relevant area. Applicants with doctoral degrees that have been awarded no more than 3 years prior to the application deadline are to be considered first. The applicant may not previously have held a position as a postdoctoral researcher for more than one year in the same subject and at the same higher education institution. The position is for a term of 24 months according to agreement with the successful candidate. If the person during the period of employment has been on parental leave, the period of employment is to be extended by the corresponding number of days. The period of employment may also be extended in the event of absence due to illness.
Assessment criteria
A basis for the assessment is the applicant’s ability to disseminate research information and communicate through high-quality publications. In addition, the applicant’s suitability for the position will be assessed. Suitability refers to the applicant demonstrating the personal qualities required to successfully perform the duties and responsibilities at hand, the ability to cooperate with other members of staff, and the ability to contribute to the development of the operations. A successful applicant should demonstrate strong interpersonal skills, the ability to work collaboratively with colleagues from diverse backgrounds, and a commitment to respectful and ethical professional behaviour.
Particular attention is to be paid to the applicant’s prospects of contributing to the future development of both research and education. Importance is also attached to a demonstrated ability and ambition to embark on a career within academia.
A successful applicant should:
Be autonomous and show strong and independent problem-solving skills and critical analytical abilities,
Demonstrate a strong background and publication track record within gear technology area, preferably with knowledge of tribology testing, manufacturing and surface treatment simulation. A background in relevant simulation techniques is also given weight when considering candidates.
Have a passion for research in advanced topics for the development of gear manufacturing and surface treatment.
